Title: Ruby On Rails Developer 
 Location: Columbia, SC 
 Duration: 7 months 
 Job ID: 7510 
 Pay rate: 95/ Hour on C2C 
 THIS IS 100% REMOTE POSITION 
 REQUIRED SKILLS (RANK IN ORDER OF IMPORTANCE): 
 RUBY, RAILS, GIT, JAVASCRIPT, WEB SECURITY, LINUX EXPERIENCE, SQL, JQUERY, REST API EXPERIENCE, JSON, 
 EXCELLENT ORAL AND WRITTEN COMMUNICATION SKILLS, TEST-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT
 PREFERRED SKILLS (RANK IN ORDER OF IMPORTANCE): 
 COMMAND LINE, SSH, HAML, SCSS, ABILITY TO WORK INDEPENDENTLY, CREATING TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION, PRIOR EXPERIENCE WORKING AS A REMOTE CONTRACTOR
 Test-Driven Development, Command Line, SSH, HAML, SCSS, ability to work independently, creating technical documentation, prior experience working as a remote contractor. 
 
 EDUCATION: BACHELOR’S DEGREE PREFERRED

 Participates in all phases of the development and implementation process. Ensures the integration of the web servers and all other supporting systems by using message based middleware and interfacing with relational databases. Be knowledgeable of best-practices for building secure web applications. 
 Responsible for developing client-side scripting and server-side application code. Extensive knowledge in using programming languages. May require a bachelor's degree in a related area and 5-7 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
